    protected List<PbcsDimension>
    PbcsPlanTypeImpl.buildDiscoveredDimensions(List<PlanTypeDimension> dimensions, boolean validateDimensions)
    Builds a list of PbcsDimension objects from already-deserialized plan-type dimension entries, as returned by PbcsPlanTypeImpl.fetchPlanTypeDimensions(), classifying each dimension's type from its getDimType() value and, if requested, validating each dimension using the response's own isValid() flag rather than issuing per-dimension REST calls.
